name: Marching Cubes Smoothing
definition: A function that takes a 2D or 3D binary embedding array and produces a smooth version of it. It assigns negative values to areas where the binary array is 0, and positive values where it is 1. This preserves fine details and thin structures that are often eroded by other smoothing methods.
summary: Marching Cubes Smoothing converts binary volumes into continuous scalar fields to eliminate jagged artifacts while preserving fine details, unlike standard methods that erode geometry.
